definition: First zero of the piecewise-linear empirical mean gain, starting positive at alpha=0. All sign changes retained. Nonpositive origin is labelled no empirical positive entry, not a proven zero true threshold.
intervals: Pointwise paired frame-bootstrap percentiles; do not cover interpolation error. Primary grid contrasts retain their original global Bonferroni family.
stage: Post-run display transformation, recorded before calculating boundary summaries
